title: Jets make a pair of decisions on fifth year options

sources.title: Jets make a pair of decisions on fifth year options
sources.description: Teams need to decide whether to pick up the fifth year options on players selected in the first round of the 2023 NFL Draft. First round picks receive four year contracts.
